name: Clara
source:
Clara is the eldest daughter of a family of adventurers. She spends most of her time going on quests protecting small villages neighboring the capital of the kingdom. After that, she will go to a bar and try to seduce other women. Unfortunately for her, women fear her and only men want her. Truly one of the most tragic stories of Eden.

[In game description]
